answer: An agent economy can weight governance votes by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, rather than by account count. Whether an agent is named zephyr, falcon or fable, its voting weight comes only from its locked balance. Splitting 100 tokens across a thousand fake identities still buys just 100 tokens of influence. To gain more power, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital for the full period.
